storyCards.headline: Far Behind: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Candlebox's "Far Behind" reached #18 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Far Behind" is a song by the American rock band Candlebox from their eponymous debut album (1994).

The song was released as the album's third single on August 22, 1994.

It was the band's second and final entry on the Billboard Hot 100, where it peaked at number 18 after spending nearly a year on the chart, making it their highest-charting song.

The song peaked at #18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.
